刚开始玩还比较上头，但内容量和地图都实在太少了，玩两三个小时就能把所有天赋点满...... 几个可以优化的点： 1.地图风格太少.....永远都是一个沙滩海水。（可以出不同的季节的水域、核电站下水道之类的 2.精英死亡后会造成大范围减速，一旦数量多了会爆卡，非常影响体验。 3.成长没有深度，鱼种的玩法差异化太小，可以考虑出一些特化型，格子少的可怜但属性很好的鱼种。 4.当天赋点满后就没有了成长所带来的的驱动力，也没有多少提供收集元素，后面东西解锁的越多越污染卡池。 5.升级禁用异变有时候没有效果，禁用的卡后面还能出现。 6.人类威胁度太低，而且几乎所有精英鱼都是驱散+召唤自爆鱼和放屁.......没有测试版的压制力强 7.慎用变异眼球，高频黄闪癫痫警告

Pretty cool little game, worth the few bucks I spent on it. The game tries to emulate parts of what made the intro sequence to spore so fun, the game loop is similar to every Survivors-like, you kill, you get score, you get a pick of a few random upgrades and rinse and repeat. The game loop is as satisfying as it is simple, however I do feel like you run out of combos quite quickly and thus end up getting a little bored. The game requires some more content and I would even say some more animation depth as it just doesn't have the same wow factor as other Survivors-like games.
Fun game, interesting, would definitely recommend

was a huge fan of the original renditions (sea of mutation/radiation/rebirth) but was originally put off by how similar the sequel looked to the originals. was this simply another re-release by the dev or was it an honest-to-god sequel? much to my surprise and delight: its an honest-to-god sequel with a myriad of updates, new features, new game mechanics, new game modes, new maps, etc. (basically everything one would expect for a sequel to a game of this nature)...the price is right, the game is great, and replayability is high. glad i took the plunge with this one.

absolutely worth its price and then some, i think these guys could easily charge at least double what it is currently. ive gotten several hours of fun out of it already and i still have so much left to try! reminds me a lot of the spore cell stage except with lots more mutated chaos. there are only 3 complaints i have: the english translation is really bad and it doesnt explain some of the mechanics to you very well. you can mostly understand about 80% of the game but some things will be translated badly and a bit hard to understand. secondly, the stuns and slowdowns when you remove a bosses life/kill it outright. every time you get rid of one of a bosses lives it knocks you back and stuns you, and towards the end of the run this happens constantly and is quite annoying. same thing for when you actually kill one, it goes slowmo and knocks you back, very annoying and thirdly id just like if it got harder as you progress so that you could compete with yourself to last longer and longer. as is, after getting all the upgrades, you could pretty much last forever without any other fish even threatening you other than that, it was 6 dollars well spent, ive really enjoyed it

The game is good, fairly mindless fun. I've clearly put plenty of hours into it! Unfortunately, it's buggy as all get out and it isn't very clear what you need to do to unlock maps, etc. During game play, you can get stun locked and all you can do is drift around the map and hope that the game fixes itself before the timer runs out. There's also a health bug where your hp will go negative, but you don't die. Essentially an unintended god mode; it's rather fun to play without worrying about exploding. This one isn't a bug but an oversight in game play. The "currency" is DNA strands. You collect them by killing elites (bosses) and other mutants. The strands are used to unlock features in the Genes menu. You'll reach a point where you've unlocked everything, making the currency worthless, yet you keep gaining strands. It'd be cool if you could convert them into additional power-ups or something. Pros: Fun, low thought required. Cons: Poorly translated, buggy, hard to understand what's needed to open new maps
